santiago-giacobbe-sa.flagship_grapes: 100% Tannat, a blend of young Tannat from southern Montevideo and overripe Tannat from Parada Daymán (Paysandú).

tercetto.history: Family winery in La Paz, Canelones, which according to its INAVI listing has about 35 years of history and makes fine wines by artisanal methods.
highlights: Family winery with about 35 years of history, according to its INAVI listing.

terrazul.history: Winery located on Ruta 1 near Libertad, San José, an hour from Montevideo. It has 30 hectares of vineyard on clay soils rich in organic matter, on rolling terrain with natural drainage, and the team is led by French winemaker Didier Cornillon.
highlights: 30 hectares of vineyard an hour from Montevideo, according to INAVI.
Clay soils with organic matter and Atlantic winds near the mouth of the Río de la Plata.
Team led by French winemaker Didier Cornillon.

tunin.history: Family winery on Ruta 3 km 83.5, about 10 km from San José de Mayo, started in 1934 by the grandfather of the current generation according to its own listing on WinesOf. Rubén Tunin is listed as the winery's contact person; it operates as Tunin Hnos SRL.

vina-eden.history: A project of Mauricio Zlatkin, a native of Rio de Janeiro, who bought the land in the hills of Pueblo Edén in 2005 and planted the first vineyards in 2008. The winery, built in 2015 on the hillside, ages its wines in a cellar dug into the hill's rock.
highlights: It ages its wines in a cellar dug into the hill's rock, according to the winery.
Granitic, stony soils in the hills of Pueblo Edén, about 20 km from the sea.
It generates wind and solar power and moves grapes and wine by gravity across three levels.
vina-eden.flagship_grapes: Blend of Tannat 60%, Merlot 30% and Marselan 10% (2016); fermented and macerated in concrete, 26 months in concrete vats and first- and second-use oak barrels.

vina-maschio.history: Viña Maschio is a family venture located at Ruta 7 km 32.5, in Canelones. Hércules Maschio started the business in 1953; his son Hugo, a notary by profession, took over in 1972, built the winery in 1974 and made the first vinification in 1975. In 2021 the fourth generation joined, in the person of agronomist Franco Maschio. It has 29 hectares planted, mostly with fine varieties, and sells most of its wine in bulk, bottling a smaller fraction under the Rebel brand.
highlights: Founded in 1953 by Hércules Maschio; the winery was built in 1974 and the first vinification took place in 1975
29 hectares planted, mostly with fine varieties
Own brand Rebel: red and rosé from Marselan and Tannat
10 permanent workers plus seasonal staff for pruning and harvest
vina-maschio.flagship_grapes: Marselan and Tannat; red, the house's only bottled brand (also made as a rosé).

vina-progreso.history: Personal project of winemaker Gabriel Pisano, started in 2009 after harvests in the United States, Chile, South Africa and Spain. It has no vineyards or physical winery of its own: it buys grapes from growers in Progreso, including the Pisano family estate, and makes signature wines with minimal intervention, native yeasts and little or no sulfite.
highlights: No estate vineyards: buys grapes in Progreso, including the 30 ha Pisano family estate.
Overground range with Sangiovese, Viognier, Cabernet Franc and Syrah; labels designed by his aunt Elisa.
Sueños de Elisa scored 95 points from Tim Atkin, according to the South America Wine Guide.
vina-progreso.flagship_grapes: Tannat fermented in open barrel with native yeasts; Underground range

vina-santa-teresa-s-a.flagship_grapes: Red table wine in 1 L packaging; the range includes a classic red and a white.

vina-varela-zarranz-bodegas-vudu.history: Diego Pons, one of the pioneers of Uruguayan winegrowing, planted vines and built the manor house of the Suárez estate in 1888; the underground cellar dates from 1892. The Varela Zarranz family, in the wine business since 1933, bought the estate in the 1940s, and four generations work there today.
highlights: Underground cellar from 1892 with French barrels; the winery presents it as the largest collection in the country.
Vineyards in two areas with different soils: Suárez and Cuatro Piedras.
Century-old olive trees along the access road and a park with old araucarias and eucalyptus trees.
vina-varela-zarranz-bodegas-vudu.flagship_grapes: Gran reserva red; the winery does not publish the blend or the aging.

vinas-del-636.history: Viñas del 636 is a family venture in Rivera, on the Héctor Gutiérrez Ruiz highway km 7, which defines itself by its commitment to wine tourism. It receives visitors every day by prior reservation to tour the vineyards, winery and cellar, with a wine tasting accompanied by breads, cheeses and cold cuts.
highlights: Visits every day by reservation: vineyard, winery and cellar, with a tasting of wines, breads and cheeses.
Harvest experience with a tasting of the year's vinifications and five wines with cheeses (INAVI, 2025).
vinas-del-636.flagship_grapes: Young, fruity Tannat, without oak aging, from the estate's own grapes.

vinedos-y-bodega-gamba.history: Family estate in Sauce, Canelones, where the first rows of vines were planted in 1904. The family historically produced table wines and later VCP (vino de calidad preferente, quality wines), and according to INAVI it is developing a new premium line and focusing on wine tourism.
highlights: First vines planted in 1904 in Sauce, Canelones.
Hosts the 'Atardecer en el viñedo' event (2026 edition, 24 October), according to INAVI.
vinedos-y-bodega-gamba.flagship_grapes: VCP line of food-friendly wines; the first wine of the new line was a 2020 Marselan, made with native yeasts.

vinas-del-quinton.history: A project founded in 2010 in the El Quintón locality, 25 km from Colonia del Sacramento, combining vineyard, its own winery and an olive oil mill. The vines, Cot Malbec, were planted from 2012 onward and the first label came from the 2018 harvest. It is run by agronomist Martín Chivetti.
highlights: Cot Malbec and Syrah vineyard on rolling hills by the Quintón stream, Guyot-trained.
Its own gravity-flow winery and olive mill: it also produces extra virgin olive oil (Piedras del Olivar).
Petra 2019 (Malbec-Cabernet Franc): 90 points from Tim Atkin, according to the winery.
vinas-del-quinton.flagship_grapes: 100% Malbec; reserve red with 16 months in French oak barrels.

vinofi-srl.history: Vinofi SRL appears in the INAVI winery registry with a facility at Camino Russi 4446, in the Peñarol Viejo area of Montevideo. It shares its address and coordinates with Vinícola Aurora S.A., the Uruguayan subsidiary of the Brazilian cooperative Aurora. No online presence of its own or information about its wines was found.
highlights: Shares its INAVI address and coordinates with Vinícola Aurora S.A. (Camino Russi 4446)

vinos-antonietta.history: Vinos Antonietta is registered with INAVI under the name of Antonietta Rinaldi, with a winery at Francisco Azarola 2382, in the Colón and Melilla area in the northwest of Montevideo. The registered contact email belongs to the Envasadora Melilla domain. No website or published information about its wines was found.
highlights: Registered with INAVI under the name of Antonietta Rinaldi, in the traditional wine-growing area of Melilla
Its registered contact uses the Envasadora Melilla domain

vinos-baioni.history: Ivo Baioni arrived from Cupramontana (Italy) aged 13; the family settled in the Colonia de Juanicó and later bought land on Ruta 107, in Canelón Chico, where they grew fruit and vines. In 1991 he founded the winery with his sons Roberto and Carlos. Today the third generation runs it: Roberto and Sandra with their children Jeniffer and Franco.
highlights: Registered company name Ivo Baioni e Hijos Ltda., according to the INAVI registry
vinos-baioni.flagship_grapes: Table wine under the Baioni brand; the source does not name the grapes.

vinos-borges.history: Winery of the brothers Washington, Leonel, Gerardo and Edison Borges, in Canelones, who launched their own wines on the market.
highlights: Legal name Borges Hnos. SRL, according to the INAVI register

vinos-campiglia.history: Family winery in Colorado Chico (Canelones) dedicated to making artisanal wines.
highlights: Registered with INAVI in the name of Mauricio José Campiglia Campi

vinos-de-la-carolina.history: Bodega De La Carolina was founded in 1923 by Ángel Coasini, an immigrant from Piedmont (Italy) with knowledge of viticulture and winemaking. Today it is run by the fourth generation of the family, at Ruta 67 km 38.500, Sauce, Canelones. It grows Tannat, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay, harvested by hand, and makes reds, whites, rosés and sweet wines.
highlights: Founded in 1923 by Piedmontese immigrant Ángel Coasini; now in its fourth generation
Vineyards of Tannat, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay, harvested by hand
Offers a one-hour tasting and guided tour, as well as private events
vinos-de-la-carolina.flagship_grapes: Tannat with 18 months in barrel; about 2,000 liters per vintage (first vintage released: 2019).

vinos-don-carmelo.history: Winery registered with INAVI under the company name Don Carmelo Ltda., located in the rural locality of La Aldea, on Ruta 26 east of the city of Tacuarembó. It is one of the few wineries registered in that department and offers direct sales at the estate.
highlights: One of the few wineries registered with INAVI in the department of Tacuarembó.

vinos-don-roque.history: Family winery in Rodríguez, San José, which according to INAVI has been making wine for almost 40 years and is in the hands of the third generation. It offers a shop and tasting tours.
highlights: Family winery in Rodríguez (San José) with almost 40 years of winemaking, according to INAVI.
Third generation of the family at the helm.

vinos-el-vasquito.history: Vinos El Vasquito is registered with INAVI under the company name Durbemar SRL, with a winery at Camino Pedro Sanguinetto 5390, Rincón del Cerro, in the rural west of Montevideo. No website or published information about its history, vineyards or wines was found.
highlights: Company name Durbemar SRL, according to the INAVI registry
Located in Rincón del Cerro, a rural area in the west of Montevideo

vinos-firpo.history: Vinos Firpo is registered with INAVI under the company name Bodega Rafir SC, based at Calle 26 y C, in the city of Paysandú. The registered email corresponds to Raúl Firpo. It is one of the few wineries registered in the country's northern littoral. No website or published information about its wines was found.
highlights: Company name Bodega Rafir SC; registered contact in the name of Raúl Firpo
One of the few wineries registered with INAVI in the department of Paysandú

vinos-guarini.history: Vinos Guarini is registered with INAVI under the company name Olbiner SA, with a winery at the junction of Ruta 67 and Ruta 32, Canelón Chico, Canelones. No website or published information about its history, vineyards or wines was found.
highlights: Company name Olbiner SA, according to the INAVI registry

vinos-introini.history: Vinos Introini (Bodega Introini) is registered with INAVI with a winery at Ruta 67 km 32.200, Camino Paso del Medio al Norte, Canelón Chico, Canelones; the listing is in the name of Mari Blengio. No website or published information about its history, vineyards or wines was found.
highlights: INAVI listing in the name of Mari Blengio; email registered as Bodega Introini
vinos-introini.flagship_grapes: Soft Muscat rosé; also sold in a 3 L jug.

vinos-la-alegria.history: Vinos La Alegría is registered with INAVI under the name of Wilson González Pereira, with a winery at Ruta 84 km 37, Sauce, Canelones. It shares its telephone and contact email with Vinos Miguelito, another Sauce winery registered with INAVI. No website or published information about its wines was found.
highlights: Registered with INAVI under the name of Wilson González Pereira
Shares its telephone and contact email with Vinos Miguelito (Sauce)

vinos-la-estancia.history: In the early 20th century Mario Rodríguez Pagardoy and Marta García Brouchou began planting vines on their small farm in Punta Yeguas, in the west of Montevideo, and in 1937 they founded a small winery. Four generations later, the family makes table, fine, reserve and frizzante wines and a Tannat liqueur under the La Estancia brand.
highlights: Winery founded in 1937; fourth generation of the Rodríguez family.
Vineyards in Punta Yeguas and La Colorada, just meters from the Río de la Plata.
More than a dozen varieties, with Tannat as the main one, according to INAVI.
vinos-la-estancia.flagship_grapes: Tannat; top-of-the-range gran reserva, a tribute to the winery's founder, Marta García Brouchou.

vinos-las-parras.history: Vinos Las Parras is a venture of the Peisino family in the Los Cerrillos area of Canelones, registered with INAVI under the name of Marcelo Javier Peisino Espinosa. According to its listing, it is devoted to making wine in the most artisanal way possible, solely from the estate's own grapes, and the family combines the winery with dairy farming.
highlights: Artisanal winemaking solely from estate grapes, according to its INAVI listing
The Peisino family combines the winery with dairy farming

vinos-miguelito.history: Vinos Miguelito is registered with INAVI under the name of Miguel Ángel Cappi Chiappella, with a winery at Ruta 7 km 30.700, Sauce, Canelones. It shares its telephone and contact email with Vinos La Alegría, also from Sauce. No website or published information about its wines was found.
highlights: Registered with INAVI under the name of Miguel Ángel Cappi Chiappella
Shares its telephone and contact email with Vinos La Alegría (Sauce)

vinos-nueva-estirpe-y-vinos-toledo.history: Vinos Nueva Estirpe y Vinos Toledo is a winery registered with INAVI with two brands and its base at Toledo Chico 4996, in the rural northeast of Montevideo; the listing is in the name of Juan José Valdi. No website or published information about its history or wines was found.
highlights: Operates with two brands registered with INAVI: Nueva Estirpe and Toledo
INAVI listing in the name of Juan José Valdi

vinos-pampero.history: Vinos Pampero is registered with INAVI under the company name Pampero S.A., based at the corner of Calle Durazno and Rocha, in the town of Progreso, Canelones. No website or published information about its history, vineyards or wines was found.
highlights: Company name Pampero S.A., according to the INAVI registry
Located in the town center of Progreso, a historic wine-growing town of Canelones

vinos-rigali.history: Vinos Rígali is registered with INAVI under the name of Mirta Rigali, with a winery at Ruta 6 km 34, Sauce, Canelones. No website or published information about its history, vineyards or wines was found.

highlights: INAVI listing in the name of Isidro Scuadroni; email registered as Bodegas Cuadroni

vinos-secchi.history: Vinos Secchi is registered with INAVI under the company name Secchi Hnos. Ltda., with a winery at Ruta 1 km 48, department of San José. No website or published information was found on its history, vineyards or wines.
highlights: Company name Secchi Hnos. Ltda., according to the INAVI registry
vinos-secchi.flagship_grapes: Sweet white table wine in a 1.5-liter bottle; the source does not state the grapes.

vinos-valpasos.history: Vinos Valpasos is registered with INAVI under the company name Argoril SA, with a winery at Camino Poquitos 5503, Canelones. No website or published information about its history, vineyards or wines was found.
highlights: Company name Argoril SA, according to the INAVI registry

vinoterra-s-a-s.history: Vinoterra is a venture of the Abelando Balma family (Leonardo Abelando, Gianela Balma and their children Ignacio and María Emilia) in Pueblo Esperanza, Paysandú, on Ruta 90 km 13.8, opposite the Capilla San José. They planted Marselan in 2017 and Arinarnoa in 2018, in a small vineyard of 1,840 vines per variety, with winemaker Melissa Barrera. It obtained LSQA sustainable vineyard certification in 2023 and sustainable winery certification in 2024, and opened as a wine-tourism winery on Heritage Day in October 2024.
highlights: Defines itself with INAVI as a family boutique winery with guided visits and sociocultural activities
One of the few wineries registered with INAVI in the department of Paysandú
vinoterra-s-a-s.flagship_grapes: Red Marselan, from its own vineyard with LSQA certification for sustainable vineyard and winery.

vitivinicola-galicia.history: Vitivinícola Galicia is registered with INAVI under the company name Domínguez Hnos. Ltda., with a winery at Ruta 80 km 73, Soca, in the east of the department of Canelones. The registered email identifies it as Bodega Domínguez. No website or published information about its history, vineyards or wines was found.
highlights: Company name Domínguez Hnos. Ltda.; email registered as Bodega Domínguez
Located in Soca, an unusual area for wineries in the east of Canelones
